The '''Skirmish on Iope''' was an event that occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] and the 10 [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] he hired for a job. X-7 wanted to test the skills of the mercenaries by opening fire on their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] as they approached the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iope]] where he was waiting. X-7 was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] 5 of the mercenaries before [[Lune Oddo Divinian]], one of the mercenary [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], figured out that the visible base on the moon's surface was just a decoy. He then found the camouflaged weapons embankment and successfully destroyed them, ending the test.<ref name="RF4" />
